title: Two more Llama models for text and vision
summary:
Two Llama models joined the API, optional input safety gained a large-request follow-up, and three community apps entered the catalog.

The team added `llama-maverick` and `llama-scout` for text and image input. Maverick supports tools and a 1,048,576-token context window; Scout has a 10,000,000-token context window without tool support. The existing `llama` route now uses Llama 3.3 70B Instruct.

The team added opt-in request checks for text, chat, image, video, and audio generation, selectable with `safe` or the `Pollinations-Safe` header. Checks can redact matching private information or block matching input. A follow-up lets large safety-enabled requests scan the latest 50,000 text characters across up to 25 text parts instead of rejecting them solely for size; earlier context remains unchanged.

Agent-maintained catalog updates added Lkalma, an offline-first collaborative whiteboard; Storyframe Studio, a text-and-image creative workspace; and Pollinations AIGC Control Console, a dashboard for generative AI workflows. The README showcase also received attribution, link, and duplicate-entry cleanup.

highlights.title: Llama 4 Maverick
highlights.text: Use `llama-maverick` for text and vision requests, with tool support and a 1,048,576-token context window. It is paid-only. [Browse Maverick](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-maverick).

highlights.title: Llama 4 Scout
highlights.text: Use `llama-scout` for text and vision requests with a 10,000,000-token context window. Scout does not support tools. [Browse Scout](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=llama-scout).

highlights.title: Choose input safety checks
highlights.text: Add `safe` to a query string or request body, or use the `Pollinations-Safe` header, to opt into input checks across text, chat, image, video, and audio generation. Choose checks for privacy, secrets, sexual content, violence, or prompt shielding. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
